assessment: Alpha944: Fixed a real LLUDP CircuitConnection/WorldModel region-identity inconsistency after Alpha924 handshake admission. Previously a decoded AgentMovementComplete with correct authenticated AgentID/SessionID but a wrong, nonzero RegionHandle and finite position could mark CircuitState active and issue initial Low381 although WorldModel rejected that foreign region and never admitted the own avatar pose. Admission now enforces EXACT 64-bit LoginSession region_x<<32 | region_y handle, identical to application WorldModel login region. Legacy logins with both coords zero keep deferred WorldModel verification; legitimate x=0 or y=0 edge-of-world region with other nonzero coordinate still matched strictly. Separate bounded wrong-region Low15 CircuitStatus and F3 count added without leaking agent/session identifiers. Native real LLUDP encode/decode regression extended with mismatched handles, legacy both-zero and x-zero edge, Mint/Pi5 ARM64 headless, Python production-source contract and full Mint x64 GUI gate. Previous Pi5 Alpha934 exact feature SHA f9d8a75 Run 39992793374 completed success. OpenGenesisLINK main ccfc644d unchanged. Authenticated NexVerse AvatarAppearance/COF/Skin/Outfit GPU pixels and simulator-confirmed WASD/Yaw live E2E still open; no deploy.
